_comment: Advisories the CI audit gate may ignore. Each needs a reason and a review date; scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails once review_by has passed or the advisory is gone, so exceptions can't be forgotten.

advisories.reason: ReDoS via crafted glob patterns. Dev-only: pulled in by ESLint and eslint-config-next, which match file globs from our own config, never user input. Not in the deployed image (the nginx stage holds only static files). No patched picomatch release exists yet.
